title: An etale representable morphism of formal algebraic spaces induces a cocontinuous functor on the small etale sites
author: The Stacks Project Authors

difficulty_reason: For a morphism of formal algebraic spaces which is representable by algebraic spaces and etale, the lemma asserts that there is a cocontinuous functor between the small etale sites, that the induced morphism of topoi is the one associated to it, and that the functor is continuous as well (statement lines 7453-7462). The proof reduces the assertion to the corresponding statement for algebraic spaces, which requires knowing that the induced morphism between the reductions is etale: it observes that the base change of the morphism along the reduction of the target is an algebraic space etale over a reduced algebraic space and therefore reduced itself, so that the reduction of the source is that base change, and hence the induced morphism of reductions is etale (proof lines 7464-7477). The claim is H2: the reduction to the case of algebraic spaces is displayed in full, and the only input is the reducedness of an algebraic space etale over a reduced one.
